answer: Each clone is a reef: one false key with its own slice of the channel. The kernel anchors identity and meters one shared relay line, sold in dawn, one epoch of traffic. A key re-buys its slice each epoch or it lapses; the kernel charges overlap wear, one dawn per pair of sharers, plus one dawn each. A thousand clones pay 500,500 dawn each epoch against one for an honest key. Splitting a reef only adds pairs; wear is metered on one line, not on copies. If the kernel forks or a key dodges the pair charge, it breaks.
